scope: Specific to the quark instance at http://odroid.lan:8080 as observed on 2026-10-09; not quark d8d2618e and not the phase-2 dataset.

instance.backendCommitNote: GET /api/v0/version requires an admin session; it was not queried, so the backend commit is unknown.
instance.frontendUnchangedAfterRuns: index.html and main.dart.js fetched again at 2026-10-09T22:13:42Z had the same sha256
instance.account: an existing account supplied by the owner through FLIGHTHOUSE_USERNAME and FLIGHTHOUSE_PASSWORD; its data was the instance's own and was not modified

machine.note: Other agents shared the machine during the runs; load was not controlled.

method: 15 serial `flighthouse collect` runs of quark-variance.collect.yaml, no parallel load from flighthouse. Each run signs in once, then runs Lighthouse and axe on each route. Run 01 became the baseline with `baseline --update`; `ci` ran on every run against it with the default gate (minSeverity minor, overall 2, perf 5, other categories 2).

summary.largestContentfulPaintModes: 45 route runs: 39 have simulated LCP 888-1599 ms and performance 54-59; 6 have simulated LCP 7850-8035 ms and performance 35. Observed LCP is 59-404 ms in the first group and 102-460 ms in the second.
summary.lcpScoreBoundary: Lighthouse scores LCP 0.9 at p10 = 1200 ms; flighthouse emits a finding below 0.9. 27 of the 39 fast-mode samples are at or below 1197 ms and 12 at or above 1203 ms.

gateReplay.method: Raw outputs recorded above, composed per route and gated with the real `flighthouse ci` (default gate). A median-of-N set picks, per route, the run whose Lighthouse performance score is the median of N recorded runs; this simulates a runner change that does not exist yet. `scoreOnlyGateFailed` recomputes the verdict from the reported scores alone, ignoring new findings; it simulates the proposed rule in ADR 0027 and is not flighthouse behavior.

singleRunEveryOrderedPair.description: each run as baseline, each other run as candidate

medianOf3.description: baseline median of runs 01-03; candidates every 3-run set from runs 04-15

medianOf5Baseline01To05.description: baseline median of runs 01-05; candidates every 5-run set from the other 10 runs

medianOf5Baseline06To10.description: baseline median of runs 06-10; candidates every 5-run set from the other 10 runs

medianOf5Baseline11To15.description: baseline median of runs 11-15; candidates every 5-run set from the other 10 runs

desktopPresetVariant.change: lighthouse.command [npx, --yes, lighthouse@13.5.0, --preset=desktop]; everything else identical (see quark-variance.collect.yaml)
desktopPresetVariant.confounder: These 12 runs came after the default runs, while machine load was lower, so the comparison is not controlled.
